experiences.name: Mercado de San Juan Food Tour
experiences.description: Explore one of Mexico City's most beloved gourmet markets, sampling exotic cheeses, fresh seafood tostadas, traditional tacos, and artisanal products. Chat with local vendors and discover ingredients central to Mexican cuisine.

experiences.name: Museo Nacional de Antropología Visit
experiences.description: Spend a half-day at one of the world's greatest anthropology museums, exploring ancient Aztec, Maya, and other pre-Hispanic civilizations through thousands of artifacts including the iconic Aztec Sun Stone.

experiences.name: Street Taco Crawl in Coyoacán
experiences.description: Wander through the bohemian neighborhood of Coyoacán stopping at legendary taco stands and street food stalls. Try tacos de canasta, tlayudas, and elotes while soaking in the colorful colonial architecture and local atmosphere.

experiences.name: Teotihuacán Pyramids Day Trip
experiences.description: Take a guided day trip to the ancient city of Teotihuacán, climbing the Pyramid of the Sun and Pyramid of the Moon, walking the Avenue of the Dead, and learning about one of Mesoamerica's most powerful pre-Columbian civilizations.
experiences.location: Teotihuacán, State of Mexico (45 km northeast of Mexico City)

experiences.name: Cooking Class in Roma Norte
experiences.description: Join a hands-on traditional Mexican cooking class led by a local chef in the trendy Roma Norte neighborhood. Learn to make mole, tamales, and fresh salsas from scratch using seasonal market ingredients, then enjoy your creations.
